name: HatchGrab
subtitle: Food Truck orders and kitchen
promotionalText: Take orders ahead, stop the kitchen taking more orders than it can handle and keep selling even if the signal drops. The order app for Food Truck staff.
description:
HatchGrab is the order-taking and kitchen app for Food Trucks: the tool your team uses in every trading session.

Customers order ahead and choose a collection time. Your staff see every order on one screen, confirm what the kitchen can cook, then mark the order “Ready” and “Collected”.

■ Don’t promise a time you can’t make
Set how much your kitchen can cook at once and how long it takes. When a collection time is full, customers can’t choose it, so the queue matches the kitchen’s capacity.

■ Take orders at the truck
Add walk-up orders on the same screen as orders placed ahead, so the kitchen works from one queue.

■ One screen for the kitchen
The kitchen screen (KDS) shows what to cook now, what’s next and what’s ready, with an alert when it is time to start cooking an order.

■ Print order tickets
Connect a kitchen receipt printer over Bluetooth or over your local network, then order tickets print automatically.

■ Keep selling even if the signal drops
Switch on offline protection and, if the connection drops, ordering ahead pauses so nobody places an order you don’t see. Orders you take on the device are kept and sent to the system when you are back online.

■ Built for the Food Truck vehicle
Use it on iPhone or iPad. Keep the screen on during the trading session, get a notification when an order is waiting for confirmation, and lock the app with Face ID or Touch ID.

■ Plan your week
Set up your events and places once, then take orders for each event.

HatchGrab is for Food Truck operators and their staff. You need a HatchGrab account to sign in.
